claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release is v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) in the license/cadence table and Pulumi section (inconsistent within the page).
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) in the cadence table and Terraform section.
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) in the cadence table and CDK section.
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08.
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the at-a-glance table at L142 still lists v2.4.0).
The latest OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
GitHub stars: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.

By GitHub stars, Kubernetes has roughly 127,900 stars, Terraform 49,700, OpenTofu 30,200, Pulumi 25,700, AWS CDK 12,900, and Crossplane 12,100, measured 2026-09-21; Terraform is the most-starred dedicated IaC tool.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, and the service is fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
